note: Starter catalogue written from general knowledge and NOT yet checked against official pages. Every record is marked unverified. Amounts and rules may have changed.

entries.title: PM-KISAN
entries.summary: Income support for eligible farmer families.
eligibility: Farmer family with cultivable land
Some categories are excluded, see the portal
entries.benefits: Cash support paid in instalments to a bank account. Earlier Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments; confirm the current amount.
steps: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or at a Common Service Centre
Complete e-KYC as the portal asks

entries.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
entries.summary: Health cover for hospital treatment for eligible families.
eligibility: Families listed under the scheme's eligibility data
Check eligibility on the official portal
entries.benefits: Cashless hospital treatment at listed hospitals. Earlier up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year; confirm the current limit.
steps: Check your eligibility on the official portal
Visit a listed hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk

entries.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana
entries.summary: LPG connection for women from poor households.
eligibility: Adult woman from a poor household
Household should not already have an LPG connection
entries.benefits: Support for a new LPG connection.
steps: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official portal

entries.title: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
entries.summary: Housing assistance for rural families without a pucca house.
eligibility: Rural household without a pucca house
Selection follows the official beneficiary list
entries.benefits: Financial assistance to build a house.
steps: Check the beneficiary list with your Gram Panchayat or on the portal

entries.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
entries.summary: Savings scheme for the future education and marriage expenses of a girl child.
eligibility: Account for a girl child, opened by a parent or guardian
An age limit applies at opening
entries.benefits: Government-backed savings account with interest set by the government.
steps: Open the account at a post office or authorised bank

entries.title: Atal Pension Yojana
entries.summary: Pension scheme mainly for workers in the unorganised sector.
eligibility: Age 18 to 40 at joining
Savings bank account required
entries.benefits: Fixed monthly pension after age 60, based on the plan chosen.
steps: Apply through your bank branch

entries.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
entries.summary: Basic bank account for people without one.
eligibility: Person without an existing bank account
entries.benefits: Basic savings account with a RuPay debit card.
steps: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra

entries.title: PM Mudra Yojana
entries.summary: Loans for small and micro businesses without collateral.
eligibility: Small business or planned non-farm business
Loan categories: Shishu, Kishor, Tarun
entries.benefits: Collateral-free business loans from banks and other lenders.
steps: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance lender

entries.title: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
entries.summary: Crop insurance against loss from natural causes.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
entries.benefits: Insurance payout for notified crop loss.
steps: Enrol through your bank, a Common Service Centre or the portal before the cut-off date

entries.title: PM SVANidhi
eligibility: Street vendor in an urban area
Vending certificate or survey record
entries.benefits: Small working-capital loan with repayment incentives.
steps: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or through a lender

entries.title: PM Vishwakarma
entries.summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
eligibility: Artisan working in a listed traditional trade
entries.benefits: Skill training, toolkit support and credit support.
steps: Register on the official portal

entries.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
entries.summary: Scholarship to help meritorious students from low-income families continue school.
eligibility: Student selected through the scholarship exam
Family income limit applies
entries.benefits: Yearly scholarship amount for school studies; confirm the current amount.
steps: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal when the window opens

entries.title: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana
entries.summary: Short skill training courses with certification for young people.
eligibility: Youth looking for skill training
Course-specific conditions apply
steps: Find a training centre through the official site

entries.title: Stand-Up India
entries.summary: Bank loans for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs starting a new enterprise.
eligibility: SC, ST or woman entrepreneur
New enterprise in a covered sector
entries.benefits: Bank loan for setting up a new enterprise.
steps: Apply through the Stand-Up India portal or a bank branch

entries.title: Janani Suraksha Yojana
entries.summary: Cash assistance to promote delivery in a health facility.
eligibility: Pregnant woman delivering in a government or accredited facility
Rules differ by state
steps: Contact your ASHA worker or nearest health centre

entries.title: MyScheme
entries.summary: Government of India service to search central and state schemes.
steps: Search and check eligibility on the portal

entries.title: National Scholarship Portal
entries.summary: One place to find and apply for scholarships from central and state departments.
steps: Register and apply when the scholarship window is open

entries.title: National Government Services Portal
entries.summary: Directory of government services and the portals that offer them.
steps: Find the service and follow its official link
